---
title: Database design
---

::: {.callout-warning title="Outline"}
The database material from the technical draft has not yet been verified
against supported schemas and migrations.
:::

## Purpose

Document the database structures and invariants that NADABAS relies on without
including production data or credentials.

## Planned content

- supported database platforms and versions;
- logical schema and naming conventions;
- system tables, data tables, keys, and relationships;
- connection lifecycle and configuration sources;
- validation performed by the database versus validation performed in VBA;
- transaction, concurrency, backup, restore, and migration expectations;
- compatibility rules between database and NADABAS versions.

## Review questions

- Which schema definition is authoritative and version controlled?
- Which constraints are enforced by the database?
- Which invariants currently depend on application code?
- How are credentials supplied without being stored in source or documentation?
- What recovery steps are required after an interrupted write or migration?

## Definition of done

Every table and field described here must be traceable to a supported schema or
a documented observation from a non-production environment. Unverified legacy
behaviour must be labelled as such and tracked in an issue.
